hypothesis: With the correctly supplied nine-cell corruption law, per-pair Chernoff thresholds recover the exact graph in at least99% of independent600-board source-and-noise draws.
primary: Single primary: N600 correct-law Chernoff exact graph probability>=99%, one-sided exact95% binomial lower>=.99 supports, upper<.99 falsifies, else inconclusive. N1000 and all matched contrasts descriptive.
sampling: 512 independently sampled1000-row banks without replacement within each bank from same fixed3785228 eligible pool asH4n. Cross-bank and prior-study row overlaps allowed; independent fresh RNG streams.
noise: Exactly9 distinct freecells per row, selected with float64 random priorities; tied top10 rejected; replacements uniform independently among other8digits. Original givens preserved. Each smaller n shares prefix of the same noisy bank.
estimator: Distinct sorted counts; first largest adjacent gap; floored midpoint. Retain counts<=threshold. Zero threshold if one distinct count. No geometry in producer.
audit: Source sampling replay and independent CSV reread; CPU reconstruction of every count; explicit per-row null probabilities independently recomputed (not matrix formula); minimal-tail-threshold verified; graph diagnostics; SciPy exact binomial crosscheck.
limits: Correct-law estimator is supplied original masks and corruption mechanism/count. It is not unsupervised estimation of unknown noise.
Rank-restricted control adds a prior about lower-half count clusters.
Fresh independent draws may overlap each other and earlier samples; all are from one official corpus.
Only N600 correct-law exact recovery is primary. Missing-edge safety is a theorem under stated assumptions, not an exact-recovery guarantee.
